current.description: Command-line companion to PostQuantum.Configuration. Seal (protect), open (unprotect), and rotate keys for encrypted configuration values from a shell or CI pipeline, backed by a persisted PostQuantum.KeyManagement keyring. Bulk-seal or re-seal whole appsettings.json files atomically (protect-file / reprotect-file), inspect a token's non-secret metadata without any keys (inspect), and — on .NET 10+ — generate hybrid ML-KEM-768 + ECDH P-256 recipient key pairs (keygen), seal to a recipient's public key (--recipient), and migrate a keyring-sealed file onto post-quantum hybrid wrapping (reprotect-file --to-recipient). Read values from stdin to keep secrets out of shell history. See the PostQuantum.Configuration package for the library.
